description: This file defines classes and methods related to workflow processing in the SmartClient framework, including classes like ProcessElement, ProcessSequence, Task, ServiceTask, ScriptTask, XORGateway, DecisionGateway, and UserTask, with associated methods for workflow execution and task management.

classes.name: ProcessElement
classes.description: Base class for workflow elements, providing properties and methods for workflow processing.

classes.name: ProcessSequence
classes.description: Class representing a sequence of process elements, extending ProcessElement.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Base class for tasks within the workflow.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Class representing a process containing sequences and elements, with methods to start and manage workflow execution.

classes.name: ServiceTask
classes.description: Class for tasks that perform data source operations, such as fetch.

classes.name: ScriptTask
classes.description: Class for executing custom scripts within the workflow.

classes.name: XORGateway
classes.description: Exclusive OR gateway for decision points in the workflow.

classes.name: DecisionGateway
classes.description: Gateway for decision points based on criteria.

classes.name: UserTask
classes.description: Task involving user interaction, such as editing or completing tasks.
